text_simplified: The prophets of Allah—such as Ibrahim, Ya'qub, and Isma'il (peace be upon them)—took great care to advise their children and families to remain steadfast upon Islam, establish prayer, and give zakah, and Musa (peace be upon him) prayed for his brother Harun to share in his mission. Among the greatest forms of sincere counsel to children is protecting them from causes of deviation and keeping them away from musical instruments, corrupt channels, and base websites, as well as choosing righteous companions for them.
